title: FEARFULLY AND
WONDERFULLY MADE
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: sunlight filtering through ancient forest canopy
misty green valley in soft golden morning light
peaceful river flowing through quiet woodland
gentle sunbeams on mossy woodland floor
calm woodland stream reflecting morning light
serene forest glade with soft golden rays
quiet nature landscape in peaceful dawn light

scenes.a: That mirror you looked into this morning with a critical eye is actually a reflection of His careful workmanship.
Lord God, we come before You with quiet hearts of gratitude.
Forgive us for the times we look down upon the very vessel You fashioned with such intentional love.
Your Word declares in Psalm 139:14, I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made:
marvelous are thy works; and that my soul knoweth right well.
Help us to walk through this day with a deep confidence in Your divine design.
